```python
access_token = apis.file_system.access_token_from(main_user)
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path="~/photos/", access_token=access_token)

# Example mapping: month names to destination folder names
month_to_folder = {
    "January": "spot1",
    "February": "spot2",
}
default_folder = "other"

for file_path in files:
    info = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=access_token)
    month = info.created_at.format("MMMM")
    folder = month_to_folder.get(month, default_folder)
    dest = f"~/photos/{folder}/{file_path.split('/')[-1]}"
    apis.file_system.move_file(
        source_file_path=file_path,
        destination_file_path=dest,
        access_token=access_token,
    )
```
